---
title: "Billboard Graphic"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 7

billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    values_to = "rank"
  ) |>
  mutate(week = as.integer(week)) |>
  drop_na(rank) |>
  mutate(song = paste(track, artist, sep = " - "))

top_songs <- billboard_long |>
  group_by(song) |>
  summarize(
    peak_rank = min(rank),
    weeks_on_chart = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  slice_min(peak_rank, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  slice_max(weeks_on_chart, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)

billboard_top <- billboard_long |>
  semi_join(top_songs, by = "song") |>
  left_join(top_songs, by = "song") |>
  mutate(
    song = fct_reorder(song, peak_rank, .fun = min)
  )

peak_points <- billboard_top |>
  group_by(song) |>
  slice_min(rank, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  distinct(song, week, rank)

ggplot(billboard_top, aes(x = week, y = rank, color = song, group = song)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 1, ymax = 10,
    fill = "#f3c969", alpha = 0.12
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = c(1, 10, 25, 50, 75, 100),
    color = "#d7dde5",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.05, alpha = 0.78, lineend = "round") +
  geom_point(data = peak_points, size = 3, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 1.2) +
  scale_y_reverse(limits = c(100, 1), breaks = c(1, 10, 25, 50, 75, 100)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 70, by = 10)) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set3") +
  labs(
    title = "The Billboard Hits That Climbed Highest",
    subtitle = "Ten songs ranked by their strongest Billboard position",
    x = "Week on chart",
    y = "Chart position",
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.72, "cm"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, color = "#1f2937"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "#6b7280", margin = margin(b = 12)),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#fbfcfe", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#374151"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#6b7280"),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 25, 15, 15)
  )
```
